newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST - Danish Wise Men upgrade 97 c/a estimate.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Danish Wise Men upgrade 97 c/a estimate.

text.p: The independent Danish Economic Council said in its biannual report on Wednesday that it expected a 1997 current account surplus of 16.1 billion crowns, falling to 11.8 billion crowns in 1998.
In its previous report last November, the council, known as the Wise Men, forecast a current account surplus this year of 6.3 billion crowns, dropping to 0.1 billion crowns in 1998.
In 1996, Denmark had a current account surplus of 12.3 billion crowns.
